experiment_risk_register.description: The target positive label rate changes drastically across train, validation, and test splits.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: artifacts/sprint10l/dataset_fingerprint.json shows: Train positive rate = 0.62% (31,993 / 5,160,952), Validation positive rate = 4.07% (63,849 / 1,568,399), and Test positive rate = 23.20% (419,150 / 1,806,313).
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Utilize class-balanced loss functions (Focal Loss with alpha=0.25, gamma=2.0 is already implemented in app/services/ml/trainer.py), or perform dynamic threshold calibration strictly on validation splits.

experiment_risk_register.description: Solar detectors (especially soft/hard X-ray sensors on SoLEXS and HEL1OS) degrade over time in space, altering the scaling of measured counts and rates.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: No drift correction, seasonal normalization, or self-calibrating layers exist in app/services/backfill/goes_backfill.py or app/services/ml/features.py.
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Use differential features (gradients, rolling differences) rather than absolute flux values, or incorporate satellite status/housekeeping telemetry for self-calibration.

experiment_risk_register.description: Satellite tracking gaps, orbital occultations, and instrument-specific shutdowns produce long gaps of missing data.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: multi_instrument_overlap.json shows SoLEXS and HEL1OS have 915 and 960 daily parquet files respectively. Calibration and recovery reports show ~49% calendar days are missing due to duty cycles.
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Design models that handle missing inputs (e.g. projection layers with zero-masking/dropout), or apply causal forward-filling (currently capped at 10 minutes in dataset_builder.py line 82).

experiment_risk_register.description: GOES is at 1-minute cadence, while SoLEXS and HEL1OS are at 5-second cadence. Aligning them requires resampling.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: app/services/ml/dataset_builder.py uses goes_df.asfreq('1Min') and ffill(limit=10) to force a regular 1-minute grid. There is no existing multi-cadence loader in the repository.
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Downsample SoLEXS/HEL1OS to 1-minute by computing mean/max features, or implement hierarchical temporal projections.

experiment_risk_register.description: The overlap period between GOES, SoLEXS, and HEL1OS is only 914.99 days (~2.5 years). Training a complex PatchTST model on only 2.5 years of data risks severe overfitting compared to training on the 10-year GOES baseline.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: dataset_fingerprint.json shows the train set spans 10 years, whereas the overlap train set is restricted to 1.5 years.
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Apply transfer learning (pretraining on the 10-year GOES-only split, then fine-tuning on the overlap split) or utilize strong regularizations (dropout=0.2 in model.py, weight decay=1e-4 in trainer.py).

experiment_risk_register.description: Evaluating Version 3 on the overlap test set makes it incomparable to the Version 1 baseline (which evaluates on the full test set from 2023-01-01, before SoLEXS was active).
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: production_metrics_snapshot.json shows baseline test metrics are computed over 2023-01-01 to 2026-06-14, which starts before SoLEXS operations (2023-12-13).
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Evaluate the baseline model (Version 1) on the overlap test set to produce a direct, fair comparison of TSS and Brier Score.

experiment_risk_register.description: Deploying a multi-instrument model increases dependence on real-time data streams from both GOES and Aditya-L1. Gaps in any stream could disable forecasting.
experiment_risk_register.repository_evidence: The inference endpoint app/api/v1/endpoints/inference.py expects a single combined feature matrix. If any telemetry is missing, inference returns errors or degraded outputs.
experiment_risk_register.possible_mitigation: Implement a fallback policy where the system reverts to the GOES-only baseline model if Aditya-L1 telemetry is delayed or unavailable.
